job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2016 South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission RFP for investment consulting, not the LAFPP financial statement audit services RFP. Its five-year term and unspecified extensions cannot support the requested three-year term with two optional one-year renewals.
quotes: South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission General Investment Consulting Services RFP
The contract term is expected to be five (5) years.
The Agreement may be extended for additional periods as appropriate and agreed to by the parties.
